title: Vault Status
description: Machine-readable vault financial health snapshot. Emitted by vault-check operations. Consumed by recovery and monitoring.

sufficient.description: True if balance >= cost of one full job rotation at current market price and timeout.

required_for_next_rotation.description: Estimated NOS needed for next rotation cycle. (market_price_per_second * timeout_seconds)

shortfall.description: If not sufficient: required_for_next_rotation - nos_balance. Null if sufficient.
